title: Kissed Molten German Tofu Curry
description: A romantic German dish featuring black cardamom pods and a miso marinade, this curry is sour, molten, and Jain-friendly.

ingredients.name: Extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, crushed black cardamom pods, and 1 tablespoon of olive oil to create the marinade.
Add the cubed tofu to the marinade and mix well to coat, then refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the tomato puree, vegetable broth, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir well to combine.
Bring the curry to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened.
Add the marinated tofu to the curry and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring gently to combine.
Reduce heat to low and let the curry simmer for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the Kissed Molten German Tofu Curry hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
